claim: The Γ-Max-2Lin(A) Problem is equivalent to the Maximum Section of an A-Covering Graph Problem, where A is viewed as a permutation group acting on itself by translations.
falsifier: One can verify the equivalence by constructing a bijection between instances of the two problems within the formal framework.

conditions: A is a permutation group acting on itself by translations
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the formal equivalence as derived in the source; transfer beyond the stated conditions is unestablished.

title: Computational problems: Γ-Max-2Lin–equivalence of the problems theorem
